answer: A reputation ledger that ages like an ember banked overnight resists Sybil attacks: every agent must stake tokens and earn trust slowly through verified work, so a fresh fake identity starts hollow — no history, no stake, no cheap credibility. Spinning up a thousand sock puppets costs a thousand stakes and a thousand slow histories, while one honest agent's record compounds. The fable of effortless fake crowds dies when identity is earned, not claimed.
